acceptanceCriteria: An ATR requirement states the equivalence
A test compares detached and foreground outcomes
body: Follow-up from the spike lane (2026-10-21, branch claude/batch-spike; the evidence is in docs/build-log/2026-10-21-*.md once that batch lands). V1-1557 decision: a detached claim by a holder with a live attempt under a different request id is treated exactly like the foreground claim.
title: ATR: a detached claim's outcome equals the foreground claim's (requirement and test)
